pca.biplot_convention: F=T/D; C=V*D; F C^T equals the rank-two standardized reconstruction. No arrow multiplier.
pca.axis_note: Biplot axes use unit-SD component scores; ordinary PCA uses original scores.

methodology.neighbor_space: Euclidean distance in all eleven reference-standardized features
methodology.bootstrap: 200 route resamples, scaler/PCA refitted, axes aligned; seed 20261004; shared-path dependence not corrected
methodology.cluster_stability: Saved 100-resample membership agreement conditional on fixed k=2 and feature representation; not a probability of a true category
methodology.scope: Recorded profiles, including partial itineraries and QA flags. Similarity is not validated difficulty or safety.
methodology.nonlinear: UMAP/t-SNE axes have no physical meaning; islands and between-island distances are not calibrated categories.
